notes.title: Update announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We fixed some bugs about wrong achievements and unable to get all CG.
Your achievements will upload without do anything, but if you have not collected every event-CG, please restrat from last Day at frist.
We are sorry for your troubles.

About ENGLISH & Japanese version:
We're waitting for developer to offer translation of scenario.
We'll make English version after we got translation.

Thank you for your interest in this game.
